title: Google Docs
description: Creates a Google Doc from text, or appends text to a Doc. Only Docs created by Weav are reachable.

connectionId.title: Connection
connectionId.description: Google Drive connection used to access Docs.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Create a new Doc, or append text to a Doc.

title.title: Title
title.description: Name of the new Doc. Required for create.

content.title: Content
content.description: Text of the new Doc (optional) for create, or the text to add on a new paragraph at the end for append (required). Up to 512 KiB. Plain text; the Doc is not formatted.

folderId.title: Folder ID
folderId.description: Drive folder for the new Doc. Optional, used by create. Only folders created by Weav are accessible.

documentId.title: Document ID
documentId.description: The Doc ID or its Google Docs link. Required for append. Only Docs created by Weav are reachable.
